limitations: Candidate obligation inventory only. No exhaustive API coverage, completeness certification, compiler pass state or measured compatibility claim is made.

Public library API enumeration is still required. Sections below describe representative behavioral families, not an exhaustive list of public items, associated methods, implementations, reexports or target-conditioned APIs.

Official rolling docs were verified by web on 2026-11-03. core/alloc/std reported 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13), whereas data/compiler-conformance.json pins 1.98.1 commit 48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985. The 1.98.1 std documentation URL could not be fetched. Rolling documentation is discovery evidence only, not proof of pinned API availability.

Cargo, Reference, rustc and rustdoc rolling documentation has not been reconciled to the pinned compiler release. Newer options, library items and defaults must be checked against pinned sources before becoming release-specific requirements.
Existing requirement links reference the current eighty-ID scope manifest and indicate relevant obligations only, not satisfied cells. Empty gates and unsupported capabilities remain open.

Filesystem, privileges, clocks, scheduling, CPU features, native tools, network and dynamic loader conditions require recorded environment fixtures. Environment failures must not be converted into language support or success.
Undefined behavior is not a differential runtime oracle. Unspecified outputs such as randomized hash iteration, scheduling and unconstrained allocator growth require contract-based comparisons.

API generation implementation is a reproducible extraction candidate requiring externally supplied authenticated pinned rustdoc JSON. Generating or obtaining that JSON was not performed and stable rustdoc JSON cannot be assumed available.

Category completeness requires independent review including stable proc_macro APIs, compiler/runtime intrinsics and target-conditioned platform extensions. Reconciliation does not remove any missing obligation.
